## Driver

What it is, who made it, and the source it's built from (a tag or a commit).

## Tested on

Each phone it ran on: model, GPU, Android, what happened (plays, reaches the main menu, doesn't start) and the FPS.
Link the issue or paste the Logs. Add the same phones to the JSON's `tested`.

## Checklist

- [ ] One JSON in `drivers/` or `fixes/`
- [ ] Its source is pinned to a tag or a commit
- [ ] Any patch is in `patches/` and named in the JSON
- [ ] CI built it (the check below)
